assertions.subject: VSDs
assertions.quote: Approximately 85% to 90% of small isolated VSDs undergo spontaneous closure

assertions.subject: VSDs
assertions.quote: Patients with small, asymptomatic VSDs, in the absence of PAH, typically have an excellent prognosis

assertions.subject: Eisenmenger syndrome
assertions.quote: Management of Eisenmenger syndrome is typically performed at specialized centers due to the complexity of these cases

assertions.subject: unrepaired VSDs
assertions.quote: Routine antibiotic prophylaxis for infective endocarditis in patients with unrepaired VSDs is no longer recommended

assertions.subject: cyanotic congenital heart disease
assertions.quote: Endocarditis prophylaxis is primarily indicated for individuals with cyanotic congenital heart disease
